PRIVATE SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION

A repair that survived review.

The original app was built in Codex. Two recorded Claude sessions repaired a bounded history defect; AI review caught a regression between them.

  1. Baseline: 7 pass, 2 fail
  2. First repair: 9 pass
  3. AI review: missing source timeline regression found
  4. Corrected repair: 10 pass on independent execution

Runtime: Claude Code 2.1.266. Model: claude-opus-5[1m]. This is recorded work, not a live model call or human approval.

PRIVATE SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION

Start with one useful change.

Proposed four-week evaluation in an agreed non-production environment.

  1. Agree a workflow, approved context and acceptance criteria.
  2. Deliver a bounded change with recorded checks and review.
  3. Exercise refusal/recovery and second-team reuse.
  4. Assess results and hand over evidence and operating instructions.

The customer supplies a sponsor, workflow owner, reviewer and environment owner. Price, staffing and start date are unconfirmed. No production deployment or regulatory assurance is included.

Next conversation: choose the workflow and the people who would assess it.
